headline: The DevOps and utilities area covers six supporting capabilities marked ready for release — file-path and cloud-folder detection, log retention, run timing, an in-app console view, dependency checking and sandbox preparation — of which only the path utility could be matched to code in this review.
what_is_there: The code confirms a working utility that detects a user's OneDrive location from the environment (with sensible fallbacks) and resolves configuration file paths. A sandbox runtime and its policy settings also exist, though not the setup scripts the sandbox ticket describes.
what_is_unclear: Log rotation and cleanup, execution timing, the in-app console with a hide option, runtime dependency verification and sandbox preparation scripts could not be confirmed — in each case the files reviewed were about something else (per-run output cleanup, task ordering, planning notes) or no files were retrieved at all. This is a limitation of what the review looked at, not evidence the features are absent.
suggested_action: Ask the developer to point to where log retention, run timing, the console display, dependency checks and sandbox preparation live, so those five can be confirmed directly.
